The '''Kwymar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Kwymar included [[Doniphon]], [[Kestos Minor/Legends|Kestos Minor]], [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]], and [[Telos IV]].

==History==
[[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] served in the [[Kwymar Sector Forces|Kwymar Sector Fleet]] over a decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW6.8" /> [[Ivor Drake/Legends|Ivor Drake]] represented Kwymar in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the Wars.
